title: Collective Narrative Grounding: Community-Coordinated Data Contributions to Improve Local AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing LLM performance and failure modes on a county-level local knowledge benchmark (LOCALBENCH) covering 526 U.S. counties and a participatory QA dataset, specifically measuring the frequency of geographic confusion, factual gaps, and lack of local context.

Conducting a failure taxonomy analysis on model responses to community-specific queries, calculating the percentage of errors stemming specifically from 'Cultural Misunderstanding' and disconnects from local cultural narratives.
